review_parts_recursive_recheck.archive_reconstruction_evidence: All volumes and all 951 files reconstructed and hash-verified in the immediately preceding check; this continuation completes the annotation checks.

artifacts_review_parts_references.scope: Recursive text search including ignored/hidden files. Compressed data, SQLite databases and model weights are excluded from text search; this is not a complete backup audit of artifacts.

artifacts_review_parts_references.historical_reruns: Old preparation/review scripts can require review-parts. Restore the archived workspace to rerun them; historical paths have not been rewritten.
